scope: Prevent strict-complete DWG-to-DXF export from treating an unsupported AcDb:Template description as complete output.

implementationReadiness.sourceObservation: dwgReader::decodeDwgTemplate records TemplateDescriptionUnsupported as a warning and returns tolerant read success without publishing guessed measurement. Before this slice, strictDwgReadOutcomeIsComplete rejected Error severity and HeaderSectionUnclaimedData but ignored TemplateDescriptionUnsupported. The strict-completeness gate now rejects that exact diagnostic kind while retaining tolerant input.
implementationReadiness.compatibilityDecision: Keep tolerant reading and the warning severity. Make strict-complete output reject the exact TemplateDescriptionUnsupported diagnostic kind, analogous to other warning-class evidence that output cannot safely discard.
scopeExclusions: Do not change Template byte parsing, version layouts, or description decoding without the ODA Section 22 specification and a producer-backed sample.
Do not claim Template description preservation or native template semantics.
The AGENTS.md-referenced ODA PDF is absent at ~/doc/dwg/OpenDesign_Specification_for_.dwg_files.pdf in this environment; this slice changes only the strict output gate, not a DWG byte parser.
implementationReadiness.implementation: strictDwgReadOutcomeIsComplete rejects TemplateDescriptionUnsupported alongside HeaderSectionUnclaimedData; tolerant Template decoding and warning severity are unchanged.

coverage: A synthetic complete DWG read outcome with a TemplateDescriptionUnsupported warning is refused by strict-complete output admission.
The existing destination sentinel is preserved and diagnostic names the strict read-disposition gate.
Existing opaque-source strict gate and legacy retry controls continue to pass.
Template decoding remains tolerant and does not guess or publish measurement for the unsupported profile.

escalation: Build the touched adapter and run the owning fast strict-output gate selector plus the existing focused Template field selector. No full suite or external drawing fixture is needed.
